description: Unit test class for ConfigWithFallback, testing its behavior with different configuration scenarios, such as immutability, fallback values, and configuration path handling.

classes.name: ConfigWithFallbackTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing ConfigWithFallback functionality and behavior.

methods.name: initTestFixture
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by loading a configuration file named 'test.conf'.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Asserts that ConfigWithFallback instances are immutable and that Config instances used in the class are also immutable.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullOriginalConfig
methods.description: Tests that creating a ConfigWithFallback instance with a null original Config throws a DittoConfigError with a NullPointerException cause.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullConfigPath
methods.description: Tests that creating a ConfigWithFallback with a null config path throws a DittoConfigError.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFallBackValues
methods.description: Tests that providing null fallback values raises a DittoConfigError.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithConfigWithWrongTypeAtConfigPath
methods.description: Tests error handling when the config at the specified path is of the wrong type.

methods.name: useFallBackValuesIfConfigHasNoNestedConfigAtExpectedPath
methods.description: Checks fallback logic when the original config does not have a nested config at the specified path.

methods.name: configWithEmptyFallBackValuesRemainsSameUnwrapped
methods.description: Verifies that when there are no fallback values, the configuration remains unchanged.

methods.name: useFallBackValuesIfNotSetInOriginalConfig
methods.description: Tests fallback value application when the original config does not explicitly set a particular key.

methods.name: ignoreFallBackValuesIfSetInOriginalConfig
methods.description: Ensures fallback values are ignored if the original config already has a value set.

methods.name: getConfigPathReturnsRelativePathIfConfigWithFallbackIsBuiltFromPlainConfig
methods.description: Checks that the config path returned is relative when built from a plain config.

methods.name: getConfigPathReturnsAbsolutePathIfDefaultScopedConfigIsBuiltFromScopedConfig
methods.description: Verifies that the config path is absolute when built from a scoped configuration.
